title: PAL MCP Server — Unified Multi-Model Orchestration (10k+ stars)
description: Provider Abstraction Layer — MCP server (10,200+ stars) that lets Claude Code spawn subagents on Gemini, GPT-5, OpenRouter, Ollama, Grok, Azure, and 50+ other models within a single conversation. Maintains conversation continuity across model handoffs. Key improvement over current setup: unifies all cross-model delegation under one MCP (vs. managing Codex MCP + Gemini CLI MCP separately), and explicitly supports the 'offload to fresh context' pattern for context management.
redundancy_notes: Overlaps with Codex MCP (GPT-5.4) and Gemini CLI MCP. Potential advantage: unified interface vs. two separate MCPs. Migration cost: would need to replace both existing MCPs. Evaluate whether consolidation benefit outweighs migration risk.

evaluation.reasoning: 10,200+ stars is excellent community validation and the unified interface is appealing. However, this is an IMPROVEMENT evaluation — both existing MCPs (Codex MCP with custom CLI wrapper, Gemini CLI MCP) are working reliably. Migration complexity is real: replacing two proven custom integrations, testing continuity, updating all subagent definitions. The 'offload to fresh context' pattern is the strongest novel capability — currently requires switching between two separate tools. Research question: does PAL maintain tool-call fidelity equivalent to the existing custom Codex wrapper (which handles session IDs and CLI routing)? If migration risk is low, this could APPROVE at next evaluation.
